purpose: Prove the harness end to end using a real GreenSquare content workflow.

input_contract.escalate_only_if: missing information could materially change a consequential claim or reserved decision

pipeline.output: traceable source set with GIVEN/DERIVED/INFERRED/UNKNOWN states
single useful distinction or observation grounded in the source
GreenSquare interpretation, implication, trade-off or decision principle
one content thesis that can survive channel adaptation
120-350 word native post with one complete idea
5-8 slide 1080x1350 carousel specification with one visual task per slide
asset or exact design-production specification using GSIL.DESIGN_COMMUNICATION
copy, assets, source notes, alt text/captions where applicable, CTA and proposed publish actions
execute connected-system draft/schedule/publish actions only when authorised

content_rules: Judgment must be resolved before format.
Do not create engagement bait that weakens truth or usefulness.
Never invent evidence, numbers, product capability or performance claims.
Use the canonical evidence taxonomy even if a legacy social template uses different labels.
Channel adaptation may change expression but not the underlying judgment.
The reader should leave more capable, not merely more impressed.
Default launch CTA is the free Decision Frame only when the content earns a CTA.
